instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "When a recipe of mine is started, by a wake I switched on or by a call, put its steps and its input in my own records as one job waiting for my AI, once per firing", and give it row (The recipe's id (workflow:...).).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:start-a-recipe-run and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Every recipe row runs as this tool (the recipes' row source names it in invoke_with), with the recipe's id in input.row.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: ai-job (records:read, records:write); record:workflow-recipe (records:read); record:workflow-step (records:list).
